verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms PlayCanvas ships a production 3D renderer on WebGL2 and WebGPU with automatic fallback, live material tweaking, and first-class Gaussian splat rendering. However, none of the specific modern-renderer features in the story are documented in the pack. missing for 10: PBR material documentation, global illumination or lightmap baking, shadow mapping, post-processing effects, independent or hands-on corroboration of render quality.
